# Danathar/aurora-zfs-simple#150: its ci/write-badges.sh as it was before its
# fix, building skopeo's credential argument as --creds "actor:token". Named
# .txt so nothing runs or lints it; tests/test_no_credential_in_argv.py reads it
# as a shell script and must flag the array.

creds_args=()
if [ -n "${REGISTRY_ACTOR:-}" ] && [ -n "${REGISTRY_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  creds_args=(--creds "${REGISTRY_ACTOR}:${REGISTRY_TOKEN}")
fi
